scope: Bounded primary-source follow-up on public no-account VIX/VIXW option data. Research findings only; no quote dataset, API entitlement, runtime access or trading authority.
outcome: None of these three candidates qualifies a permitted free no-account recurring VIX/VIXW option BBO source with actual side sizes and quote-event timestamps. These observations are not proof that every possible source is absent.

sources.name: ChartExchange
sources.quote_coverage: Public VIX chain displays delayed rows; the inspected table has no bid/ask, per-side sizes or quote-event timestamp. Last trade/date and volume/OI do not supply those missing fields.
sources.automation: Official API reference requires an API key and a subscription tier. Marketing page offers anonymous demonstrations trimmed to three rows; a recurring anonymous VIX quote entitlement was not established. API option chain summary, historical max pain or option bars cannot be presumed full contract BBO.
sources.historical_vs_forward: Public display is a saved/delayed chain view, not qualified forward execution evidence. No adequate historical VIX BBO dataset downloaded.

sources.name: Options Analysis Suite
sources.quote_coverage: Public server-rendered VIX page contains nine selected most-active rows dated October29 2026, not a full verified quote response. Per-side sizes and contract quote-event clocks are absent. Page summary says front expiry33days while its table lists a6-day expiry, so summary consistency also needs qualification.
sources.automation: Official MCP is included with Pro subscription and account sign-in. REST documentation states all /v1/* endpoints require an API key on API tier. Authenticated real-time chains use owner-provided broker integrations. No sanctioned anonymous full-chain export/API qualified.
sources.historical_vs_forward: Provider describes EOD historical snapshots as reconstructed state rather than trade-by-trade replay. Displayed dated rows are not qualified forward-fill evidence or adequate historical execution data.

sources.name: Obelion
sources.quote_coverage: Direct VIX detail open was unavailable in the research tool. Official methodology lists delayed Cboe chains with Polygon/Yahoo fallbacks; supplied chain fields include bid/ask but do not establish actual side sizes or individual quote-event clocks. Some Greeks are modeled, which must not be mistaken for observed data.
sources.automation: Official terms section03 prohibit automated extraction unless expressly authorized in writing. No documented permitted anonymous export/API was found. Signed-in users may use their own provider keys, which does not meet the no-account condition.
sources.historical_vs_forward: Methodology describes shared delayed cache and different refresh cadences by source. Cache/receipt time is not individual quote-event or availability time. No multi-session VIX BBO history obtained.

sources.name: Optionistics
sources.quote_coverage: Public pricing lists delayed free tools, but does not establish a no-account executable VIX BBO source with quoted side sizes and quote-event timestamps.
sources.automation: The historical download page redirected to login. Historical data downloads are a subscription feature; the published historical-download explanation states automated downloading is unsupported.
sources.historical_vs_forward: Historical downloads and delayed viewing tools do not establish a permitted recurring current VIX quote feed.

remaining_execution_requirements: Permitted recurring source access without new account or subscription under current owner preference
Actual VIX/VIXW contract identity, bid/ask, quoted side sizes and separate observation/availability/retrieval clocks
Official calendar and matching-expiry individual VX reference required by frozen rule
Qualified atomic integration with the existing sole shared500USD monthly options allowance

current_product_scope.offline_local_file_imports: Existing strict VIX research imports remain available; no relaxed schemas or modeled quotes added.
